title: Seoul pet festival brings adoption, play and conversations on loss
caption:
Seoul is hosting its first Daengnyang Days festival at Oil Tank Culture Park. From red carpet dog adoptions to pet-loss counseling, the event celebrates every stage of the human-animal bond.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul pet festival brings adoption, play and conversations on loss
